name: GenericComplianceIntake
description: Credential subject for events that don't follow GDST or FSMA conventions. Stamped server-side by api/app/service/schema_mapper.py::to_credential_subject. The full original event payload is preserved verbatim under `event`.

eventHash.title: Event hash
eventHash.description: sha256 of the canonical event JSON, hex-encoded with 0x prefix.

complianceStatus.title: Compliance status
complianceStatus.description: `compliant` for initial issuance, `superseded` for corrective VCs.

policyVersion.title: Policy version
policyVersion.description: Semantic version of the generic Guardian policy.

issuedAt.title: Issued at
issuedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp stamped by the FastAPI mapper at submit time.

supersedes.title: Supersedes (event hash)
supersedes.description: When present, this VC replaces the one identified by the referenced eventHash.

event.title: Original event payload
event.description: Full verbatim event payload as posted by the operator.

ref.title: Ref
ref.description: Runtime-injected by Guardian (parent VC reference; null for root submissions).
